members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2607: When HTTP request handling fails (network exception, HTTP 4xx/5xx response, or SSE reconnection exhaustion), no JSON-RPC error is written back to read_stream_writer, leaving the caller awaiting a response that never arrives. All four PRs address different sub-paths of this same hang: #1578 catches exceptions in _handle_post_request via a helper method; #2395 sends an error when max reconnection attempts are exceeded in _handle_reconnection; #2607 wraps handle_request_async (covering both POST and resumption paths) in a broad try/except; #2613 replaces raise_for_status with an explicit status-code check that emits a JSON-RPC error for 4xx/5xx.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2410 is a general API fix (TextIO | int) that covers Jupyter and any other environment where sys.stderr is not a valid subprocess handle, without requiring fragile IPython/ZMQInteractiveShell class-name heuristics that can break across IPython versions. PR #2020's Jupyter detection is a narrower workaround that would be subsumed by #2410 once callers learn to pass subprocess.DEVNULL or a pipe FD. #2410 also modifies both the public function signature and the internal _create_platform_compatible_process helper consistently, and updates the docstring, making it the more complete change.
